corrections.text: The headline and body give uv 0.13.5 as released on October 21 and uv 0.13.6 on October 26, which are the dates printed in uv's release notes. GitHub release and PyPI upload timestamps (UTC) are 2026-10-22 01:35 for 0.13.5 and 2026-10-27 00:47 for 0.13.6, so the notes' dates reflect a US time zone; the other dates in the article (Mozilla, AWS CLI, Azure CLI) are UTC. uv 0.13.4 is October 20 in both conventions.
